topic: Accessing new data versions via dashboard
summary_markdown: The user informed the recipient about newly added aggregates and a new super feature: dataset versioning. Admins can now select past or unreleased versions of datasets directly on the dashboard by expanding additional parameters. This allows viewing data from specific dates, such as 'Rail preds added [2020-12-19]', even though the default production dataset ('PROD: ....') will not be updated nightly; only yesterday's data is guaranteed to be complete.
action_items: Use the new super feature (dataset versioning) on the dashboard to view newly added aggregates.
